name: Ari Real Estate (Arena) Investment Ltd
summary: Ari Real Estate (Arena) Investment Ltd operates extensively within the commercial property and real estate asset sectors across Israel and Kazakhstan. The company's comprehensive activities encompass the development, establishment, acquisition, leasing, ongoing management, and meticulous upkeep of various shopping centers and malls. In addition to these core functions, it delivers specialized management support to businesses occupying commercial units within its retail complexes and maintains a diverse portfolio of other real estate holdings. Founded in 1992 and based in Tel Aviv, Israel, the company was previously known as Arena Star Group Ltd.
